blurb: KayaKing WeekiWachee offers self-guided kayak and stand up paddleboard rentals on the Weeki Wachee River. Launches take place directly from their location near Rogers Park, with no shuttle needed. Rentals are for four hours and guests can paddle upstream and float back. A souvenir shop and snacks are available on site.
